summary: A database target per member: pages in use, and their daily growth

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers. The daemon keeps up to two days of hourly size samples in meta under database_size_samples.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: slo/targets.toml gains a [database] table (max_live_gb, max_growth_mb_per_day); the request-latency read adds a database row with the newest size sample, and st doctor adds an slo/database line, info when missed.

downtime.detail: None. The hourly sample reads three pragmas and writes one meta row.

manual.detail: No manual step. Growth appears an hour after start; a full day's growth after a day of samples.

recovery.detail: Binary rollback ignores the meta row.
